title: A ransom paid in bitcoin
summary: A firm whose systems are locked buys bitcoin and pays the attacker in 1 to 3 payments.

basis.note: The report gives an average payment of about 377,000 US dollars for each incident and a lowest incident of 17,000 US dollars. It also gives settlements of about 2 million and 400,000 US dollars. The range is set around those figures at 1.26 US dollars to the pound. The range leaves out the largest payment in the report, which was 75 million US dollars.
No source read for this part gives the share of ransom wallets that a screening tool has already labelled. The value means that 1 payment in 5 goes to a labelled wallet.

steps.say: The firm buys bitcoin and sends it to the attacker's wallet.

basis.note: The largest payment in the report was made in 3 bitcoin instalments after a negotiation. The waits between payments are assumed.
